title: Piercing Frame Solo #053 (일반 허리 컷 · P8 집중형 · 픽시컷 · 초콜릿브라운 · 메이크업 만바 · 금속 금 · 공예 단일(Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting) · 체형 근육형 아워글래스·단단한 배)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her navel, the frame cutting off across her lower belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a short pixie cut. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge yellow-gold bar hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide yellow-gold ear cuff, two smaller yellow-gold rings and a small yellow-gold stud at the top; two yellow-gold pieces in a row along the outer end of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a small yellow-gold ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal. All jewelry is real yellow gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a muscular hourglass with a firm, smooth belly and strong arms.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with folk-art florals filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it, down to the bottom of the frame, is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
